[F004] The wiring is clean. Summary of the implementation:

I implemented F004's supervisor regen-to-working-tree hook. The new `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture_regen_hook.py` module exposes `maybe_regen_after_commit`, which checks if `commit_policy.mode == "child_commit"`, runs `git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD` against the resolved repo root, matches the result against `ARCHITECTURE_RELEVANT_GLOBS` (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/**`, `claude/shared/**`, `docs/plans/*/plan.md`, `docs/plans/*/features.json` — both single-segment and recursive forms via `fnmatch`), then calls `architecture.regen()` in-process to write `docs/architecture/architecture.json` into the working tree only. It NEVER stages or commits, and emits an INBOX `architecture_regenerated` event carrying `prior_fingerprint`, `new_fingerprint`, `files_added/removed/modified`, `total_modules`, `total_plans`, and a `state_transition` tag (`absent|fresh|stale -> fresh`); on regen failure it emits an `architecture_regen_failed` event and returns `None` so the volley terminal continues uninterrupted. I wired it into `supervisor.dispatch_volley` between `transcript.append_terminal` and the `signed_off` `_emit_volley_terminal` return (line 1941-1966), wrapped in a broad `try/except` so any hook-internal failure prints + skips without crashing the terminal.
